== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)]] (GEMP <code>2273_33</code>), showing the '''reconstructed original''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text (no copy of the first printing is known); the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-communing-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Communing.png]]) print PC-E2.

* '''Text source:''' reconstructed (Bill, 10 November 2026): the PC-E1 errata text of the Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT”, 23 June 2011 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]), without the sentence that errata added, “I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled.”
* '''Reconstructed text:''' “If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a Jedi here. Luminous Beings: Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1273_33</code>: Decipher art of •Wise Advice, frame, title, Special Edition sphere, Virtual Block 7 set mark), without the errata mark E. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
